title: Odaiba on Foot
blurb: Walk Odaiba under the real sun: along the seaside park's beach to the Statue of Liberty, under Fuji TV's sphere, and out to see the Rainbow Bridge lit over the bay.

travel.name: Odaiba Seaside Park, the beach お台場海浜公園
The Statue of Liberty 自由の女神像
Tokyo Teleport Station 東京テレポート駅

npcs.name: Yui 結衣
idle: Welcome to Odaiba! Twenty years ago this was empty reclaimed land. Now: a TV station, beaches, malls and a bridge.
The Yurikamome has no driver. Sit in the front seat and you're the driver. {time}.

npcs.name: Kenta 健太
idle: No swimming most of the year, but you can paddle. The sand was brought in by boat.
In summer there are fireworks over the bay. The whole beach sits and waits. {sun_line}

npcs.name: Mika 美香
idle: Everybody takes the same picture: Liberty, the bridge, the sunset. I've taken it four hundred times.
Wait for the bridge's lights. They come on at dusk, all at once.

npcs.name: Shun 駿
idle: The Yurikamome loops over the Rainbow Bridge to get up to its deck. Watch the view from the front.
Odaiba was built as a fort, in 1853, against the American ships. The old batteries are islands now.

quests.title: Odaiba
talk: Welcome to Odaiba! Look up: the sphere on the TV station, the bridge across the water.
Go down to the beach. Kenta patrols it; he'll show you the bay.

quests.title: The beach
talk: Sand from a quarry, water from the bay, and the city on the other side. Not bad.
Walk along to the Statue of Liberty. Mika's always there with her camera.

quests.title: The Rainbow Bridge
talk: Now look at the bridge. Wait till the lights come on.
You can walk across it, on the footpath under the expressway. Thirty minutes to Shibaura.

quests.title: The sphere
talk: Fuji TV's sphere: they built a ball into a building, and you can stand inside it.
Go and look at it from below. It's bigger than you think.

steps.text: Look up at Fuji TV's sphere

spots.name: Statue of Liberty 自由の女神像
lines: The French lent Odaiba their Statue of Liberty in 1998 for a year. People missed her so much a copy was cast in 2000.
Stand here at dusk: her torch, and the Rainbow Bridge lit behind her.

spots.name: Fuji TV's sphere 球体展望室
lines: Fuji Television's headquarters, Kenzo Tange, 1996. The ball is titanium, thirty-two metres across, and you can go up into it.
From inside, the bay, the bridge and on a clear day Mount Fuji.

spots.name: Rainbow Bridge レインボーブリッジ
lines: The Rainbow Bridge, 1993: 798 metres, the expressway on top and the Yurikamome and the road below, and a footpath you can walk across.
It's lit white most nights. On special nights, all the colours of its name.
